issue.title: Review the weekly bank Category-card walk trial: category share, no-category and correction rates, import continuity, skip-when-suggested, waiting-row chips
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-lc.8 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-lc land
agent. The epic plan `plan:202611/bank_weekly_category_walk.md` (wrapup phase) asks for this
trial review once the weekly Category-card walk has run for 2–4 weeks (first Monday walk:
2026-11-16).

Review the trial with Bryan, counts and percentages only (privacy rule of the plan: no
merchants, amounts, people, places, or account digits in beads, plans, or commits):

- the share of acknowledged rows that carry a `[cat::]`;
- the no-category (Space) rate and the correction rate (**Bank: set category** use, from
  Bryan — the plugin persists no telemetry);
- weekly import continuity from the bank journal's `bank.import` events;
- whether most filings accepted bob's highlighted suggestion with Enter — if so, consider
  skip-when-suggested;
- whether to show suggestion chips on waiting rows.

The outcome also informs `bob-cli-kv` (bank-feed spike, snoozed to 2026-12-14 under the
epic's `kv_snooze = hold` decision) and `bob-cli-ku` (later bank views after the trial).

task_type_fields.proposal: After 2-4 weekly Category-card walks, review category coverage, Space and set-category rates, weekly import continuity, and the Enter-accept share with Bryan; decide on skip-when-suggested and waiting-row suggestion chips, and feed the bob-cli-kv bank-feed decision.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The trial needs 2-4 weeks of real Monday walks after the epic ships; bob-cli-lc's wrapup phase records it as a proposed follow-up rather than epic work.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-lc's plan defers the walk's trial review to a 2-4 week follow-up; the land agent files it so the trial's numbers drive the skip-when-suggested, waiting-row chip, and bank-feed (bob-cli-kv) decisions.

payload.description: Trial outcome decides whether the snoozed bank-feed spike is still needed (kv_snooze = hold)
Later bank views are gated on the same 2-4 week trial
